bodyHtml:
The 2023 season marked the second and most successful year for Spindles United yet. However, the club has barely scratched the surface of what it plans to do in the coming years.

2024 will be the club's third official season, with even more growth and entertainment expected.

The Fall Showcase

The Fall Showcase will kick off the new year on Sunday, November 12, at 3:30 p.m. at the Albany College of Pharmacy & Health Sciences Turf Field.

This event will be the third official showcase the club has held.

The purpose of these events is to open the club to any prospective players looking to join the cause.

It is always a great opportunity for all types of players to meet each other and enjoy an afternoon of competitive football.

Winter

The club has always taken part in local community events and organizations, and that trend will continue into 2024.

With or without football, Spindles United is always finding ways to be involved.

Spindles will also be releasing a winter apparel collection, perfect for gift giving and club supporting.

Spring

Once the ice starts to melt and the sun begins to shine again, the 2024 Spindles United season will be in full swing.

Rosters finalized, schedule all set, and pre-season training will be underway.

All to prepare for the start of the CDSL season in early May 2024.

For the next 365 days, the club has a lot in store. However, we can't say too much yet.

We are so excited to grow for another year with all of our players and supporters!
